findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_liliphant_docs, get_liliphant_api_docs, call_any_read_api_of_liliphant, call_any_api_of_liliphant, get_me, list_meetings, ask_a_question · Private data: get_liliphant_api_docs, call_any_read_api_of_liliphant, call_any_api_of_liliphant, get_me, list_meetings, ask_a_question · Public sink: call_any_read_api_of_liliphant, call_any_api_of_liliphant, get_me, list_meetings, ask_a_question · Destructive: call_any_read_api_of_liliphant, call_any_api_of_liliphant.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_liliphant_docs, get_liliphant_api_docs, call_any_read_api_of_liliphant, call_any_api_of_liliphant, get_me, list_meetings, ask_a_question · Private data: get_liliphant_api_docs, call_any_read_api_of_liliphant, call_any_api_of_liliphant, get_me, list_meetings, ask_a_question · Public sink: call_any_read_api_of_liliphant, call_any_api_of_liliphant, get_me, list_meetings, ask_a_question · Destructive: call_any_read_api_of_liliphant, call_any_api_of_liliphant

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
